## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d29c4e0815cb28982a87de55b9e0446b1c253e04`
Local-runs: probe — the seat ran, in a detached read-only worktree of the head (no edit, no network): `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` → ✓ (SKILL.md 319/319, execution-duties 188/188, landing-operations 101/101, triage-duties 102/102, external-contributions 22/22), `node scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` → ✓ 104 files clean, `node scripts/check-skill-frame-sync.mjs` → ✓, `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs --self-test` → ✓ 7 cases, `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test` → OK (all on `7b401bfc`; the ratchet, id-lint and frame-sync re-run on `d29c4e08`)
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (L34 红线 exception, L118 `priority:p0` row, L126 paid), references/execution-duties.md, references/landing-operations.md, references/triage-duties.md, references/external-contributions.md (L3, the seat's finding), scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs + scheduled-full-run-card.mjs (the label constant and its pin) + card #27047's 「Wanted」 1–6 and ruling record 6462070130

Read at 2026-10-28T13:47Z by the `domain:skills#2` seat on the fetched head (merge-base `9ff8154c`): seven files, +16/−16, 32 changed lines ≤ 3000 (`check-governed-merges --pr 27266`: five `.claude` paths, Tier S). The claim's tier was the ceiling tier by path mandate (SKILL.md); this review is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The head is the dev's amendment over `7b401bfc` on the seat's finding (one dangling pointer, below); the six other files are byte-identical to `7b401bfc`.

### ① Derived judgments

- The maintainer's words land where a reader looks for them. SKILL.md L118 (239 B, under the 341 B table-row pin): 「插队:同轮立即派发,越过 `batch`、深度等待(`LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD`)与一切并发上限;无槽即暂停低级在飞 dev 腾位(机制 `references/execution-duties.md`);⛔ 不豁免同文件串行与认领协议」 — items 1–3 in one row, the ⛔ keeps 同文件串行与认领协议 and drops 深度等待 (now crossed). Holds against 「不受并发限制,或者宁可其他开发暂停」.
- execution-duties: L25 tail 「p0 越过 `batch`、深度等待与一切并发上限」; two new lines carry the pause mechanics exactly as the card's ⚠️ reading has them (stop the session, PR stays draft, claim untouched; `Paused-for: #<p0>` on the card; ⛔ no discard / revert / force-push; revived on the p0's landing, same claim, same branch); one new line after L48 makes the lane's open `priority:p0` the first read of every round and wake, claimed and dispatched in the same round. Holds (items 1–3).
- landing-operations: 约定①'s non-mechanical branch (6a: name the owning lane on the anchor, ring its mailbox with `Request: main-red` — the key PR #27143 landed this shift; the root-cause card stays with the lane), 约定③ (6b: one triage round ~60 min unclaimed → triage and director name card and lane in that round's report; 6c: another round → triage posts the standard claim line and dispatches ONE `os-dev` for the stop-bleed only, one per round, triage never a development lane; the stop-bleed PR's review is the lane seat's or the director's, Tier H still waits on the approver, the lane seat takes the card back through the claim line). Faithful to 「同意,补到 #27047」 / 「同意乙,一起写进 #27047」. Holds.
- triage-duties: item 5 (a full red on main and a deterministic queue red graded p0 at first touch — anchor, root-cause card, generated full-run card; a flake anchor only once read deterministic) and a one-line pointer to 约定③ — the file declares itself the triage seat's complete duties (L3), so the pointer is owed, not extra. Holds.
- SKILL.md 红线 L34 「唯一例外:无主 p0 锚卡一轮即轮报、再一轮分诊只代派止血:每轮一张,复核非分诊。」 — beyond the order's named lines but required by the card's own 6c (「this amends the maintainer's earlier 『你只处理分诊』 for this one case only」): without it 〈优先级〉's stricter-rule resolution would void 6c against 「⛔ 分诊席永不认领、派发或写码」. The seat read it as the card's text, not the dev's. Holds.
- scripts/ci: `scheduled-full-run.mjs` L366 (the live filing path through `fileCardStep`) and L1699 (the self-test fixture) `priority:p1` → `priority:p0`; `scheduled-full-run-card.mjs` L217 is the pin of L366 — the dev's reverse check (L217 at p1 → 5 failures, exit 1; restored → green) shows the pin bites. Holds (item 5's generator half).
- Line budget: every new prose line ≤120 B (the seat measured all 15 on `7b401bfc` and the one on `d29c4e08`); every paid deletion names a home the seat spot-read on the head: state-machine L19 (hold 双查) and L39–40 (retriage 判据), project-forms L38 (mailbox owes no CI), rest-channel L13/L49 (the bare dispatch command), execution-duties L156–158 (subscribe), SKILL.md 〈模板与表〉 L311/L313 (tier and Metadata-protocol template lines), director.md 职责四 L71–75, AGENTS.md PD 14 + external-contributions.md (fork PR). The fork-PR deletion's named home pointed back at the deleted line — the seat's finding — fixed in place on `d29c4e08` (L3 → 「fork PR = 提案(AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14);本文是 fork PR(head 仓 ≠ base 仓)进场到落地的四步。」, 115 B; `git grep 'fork PR 行' -- .claude` → 0). No re-wrap as currency. Holds.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: protocol text and CI-owned scripts; no package touched. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body match the claim; no `Skills-docs:` line owed; `skip-changeset` correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Order hypothesis 1 corrected by the dev: triage-duties' ceiling is 102 (the seat's order said 103 — a stale reading of the CEILINGS ledger), so that file paid two lines; landing-operations needed four new lines, paid four. The order's line count for the file (619 vs 622 on another card) is the same class of stale reading — the seat notes it as its own.
- PR body: the dev did not PATCH it after `pr_create` (role file: the dev writes the body once; the seat writes later corrections in its record). The body's 「Line budget」 row for landing-operations L7 therefore still reads its home as external-contributions.md without the rewrite; the correct row is: home = AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14, with `references/external-contributions.md` L3 rewritten in place (commit `d29c4e08`, 115 B, 22/22) so it no longer points back at the deleted line. This record is the correction.
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` NOT MEASURED locally (prerequisite packages unbuilt; no package touched); CI's Lint lane carries it — read off the head's check-runs in the ACCEPT.
- The PR title was shortened to the relay's 255-byte cap (the order's title was over it); content unchanged.
- Two observations left unfiled, agreed: `ensure-pm-labels.sh`'s `priority:p0` description stays true (it never named the depth wait); `check-half-states.mjs` H10 already patrols a stale unclaimed p0 report-only — no patrol row added for 6b's ~60-minute round (protocol text only).
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; draft, no flip by anyone.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the maintainer's scenario (a main-red p0 sat four hours as a p1 in a lane queue; a deterministic queue red graded p1 twice): the lane reads its p0s first and starts them in the same round past every cap, pausing lesser work rather than waiting; the finder stops the bleed when mechanical; an unclaimed p0 reaches the maintainer within a round and gets a stop-bleed dispatch within two; the generator files red cards at p0. No new gate; the one 红线 exception is the maintainer's own ruling, bounded to one stop-bleed per round with the review kept out of triage's hands. Holds. Residual: 「暂停」 is protocol text with no tooling behind it yet (a seat stops a subagent by hand) — fine for now, and the `Paused-for:` line makes the state readable on the card.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27047-p0-dispatch-at-once`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 — 席位终稿 · PR #27266 · head `d29c4e08` · `domain:skills#2` · 2026-10-28T13:59Z

- 改了什么:本车道的 p0 卡当轮立即派发,不受 `batch`、深度等待(`LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD`)与任何并发上限约束;没槽就暂停最低优先级的在飞 dev 腾位(分支与 PR 原样、卡记 `Paused-for:`、p0 落地即复活);主干全量红与确定性队列红首触即 p0,四小时 full-run 生成的红卡改为 p0 立卡;发现红的席位先止血,一轮无人认领即轮报点名,再一轮分诊只代派止血(每轮一张、复核不归分诊 —— SKILL.md 红线加的唯一例外,即你的「同意乙」)。四份协议文件 319/188/101/102 行,均在上限;付掉的 11 行各有家;dev 按席位复核发现补改了 `external-contributions.md` 一行悬空指针。
- 为什么改:你的原话「main 红为什么不是 p0?」「skills 规则应该要求对应车道 p0 的卡立刻派发」「不受并发限制,或者宁可其他开发暂停」「你需要立卡更新技能」,以及第 6 项「同意,补到 #27047」「同意乙,一起写进 #27047」。
- 风险与回滚:只改协议文本与一个 CI 脚本的标签常量(含其 pin),不碰产品代码;回滚 = revert。唯一放宽的是分诊红线那一条例外,边界写死(每轮一张、止血不碰根因、复核归车道或总监)。
- 先看:SKILL.md L35(红线例外)与 L119(`priority:p0` 行);`landing-operations.md` 约定①非机械分支与约定③(6a–c);`execution-duties.md` 暂停机制三行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint && node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs --self-test` 预期全绿。
- 需要你做的:无 —— Tier S,契约复核 PASS(6470738460)后席位按你今天的落地授权落地。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。15 行新文本逐行 ≤120 B、四维框架块 md5 未变、付行之家逐一抽读在;席位发现的悬空指针(fork PR 行)已在 `d29c4e08` 原地修正;dev 推翻了我「triage-duties 有 1 行余量」的读数(上限 102,非 103),属实。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg` · 2026-10-28T13:59Z

1. 形态:draft → main,首行 `Fixes #27047`,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 行首在;七个文件 +16/−16(32 行 ≤ 3000);assignee os-justin;`skip-changeset` 正确;两个 commit(`7b401bfc` + 补改 `d29c4e08`);PR 标题按中继 255 字节上限缩短。
2. 前提实测:席位在取回的 head(merge-base `9ff8154c`)上核 —— SKILL.md L118 行 239 B ≤ 表行 pin 341;四份文件行数在上限;`git grep 'fork PR 行' -- .claude` 0 命中;四维框架块 md5 `abff5f85…` 与 main 相同;scripts/ci 三处常量 p1→p0 且 pin 自测 7/7;付行之家:state-machine L19/L39–40、project-forms L38、rest-channel L13/L49、execution-duties L156–158、SKILL.md L311/L313、director.md L71–75、AGENTS.md PD 14。
3. 门禁 check-runs(head `d29c4e08`,本笔读数 2026-10-28T13:59Z):41 check-runs,25 success · 16 skipped · 0 in progress · 0 failure(`mergeable_state: clean, draft`)。dev 本地派生 43 族:42 exit 0、1 NOT-MEASURED(`check:doc-formula-expressions` 前置未建,CI 跑)钉 `7b401bfc`;补改 head 上 ratchet/id-lint/governed-prose 三项 exit 0(报告 6470650514);席位在 detached worktree 复跑 ratchet、id-lint、frame-sync、两份 ci 自测皆绿。
4. 接受的偏差:① 席位派发令的 triage-duties 上限读数错(103→实为 102),该文件付两行;② 红线例外行与 triage-duties 指针行越出派发令点名的行,但在卡第 6c 项之内,正文已申报;③ PR 正文「Line budget」的 landing-operations L7 行之家未随补改更新(角色文件禁 dev PATCH 正文)—— 以契约复核 6470738460 ③ 为更正:家 = AGENTS.md PD 14,`external-contributions.md` L3 于 `d29c4e08` 原地改写(115 B,22/22);④ `check:doc-formula-expressions` 本地 NOT MEASURED。
5. 范围外去向:none filed;Acceptance notes:`ensure-pm-labels.sh` 的 `priority:p0` 描述仍真;`check-half-states.mjs` H10 已巡查无主 p0(report-only),6b 的 ~60 分钟轮不加巡查行。`Skills-docs:` 不欠(kind none)。
6. 落地条款:Tier S;契约复核 PASS 评论 6470738460(head `d29c4e08`);全绿即席位经中继 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` 落地(本班维护者授权在案);MERGED 后关卡摘 `pm:dispatched`,SKILL.md 热文件队列放开 → #27061、#27062、#27117。
